hypotheses.P0_product_path_is_quadratic: Degree-2 interpolation of the native product path reaches at least 0.95 delta-normalized fidelity in every cell.
hypotheses.P1_quadratic_materially_beats_linear: Degree-2 product fidelity exceeds degree-1 by at least 0.20 in every cell.
hypotheses.P2_cubic_adds_little: Degree-3 product fidelity exceeds degree-2 by at most 0.03 in every cell.
hypotheses.P3_product_path_is_nearly_planar: The top two singular directions explain at least 0.99 of centered product-path energy in every cell.
hypotheses.P4_midpoint_derivative_is_a_secant_progr: The midpoint product derivative has relative endpoint error at most 0.20 in every cell.
hypotheses.P5_quadratic_write_description_transfers: Degree-2 write fidelity differs by at most 0.05 between FineWeb and TinyStories at each layer.
hypotheses.P6_curvature_is_material: The fitted quadratic coefficient has at least 0.15 of linear-plus-quadratic coefficient norm in every cell.
